tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search published AI software listings by free text, category slug or pricing model. Returns a total plus compact summaries.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Return the full public listing for one tool by slug, including its Markdown copy and related tools.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List every active category with its slug, description and the number of published tools in it.

tools.name: compare_tools
tools.description: Compare two to five published tools side by side. Unknown slugs are reported in missing instead of being guessed.
